laws.rule: Smartraveller says the roads around the President's official residence (State House, Chancellor Avenue, The Avenues, Harare) are closed between 6 pm and 6 am. It says security there is strict: don't look through the gates or hang around outside the walls, and don't rely on GPS around the area.
